analysis: R1, comprising sol-discovery-f47d13b1-e471-4e0b-93f6-715c2a9cb5cf/SOL-1 and astra-discovery-c922dd48-9c47-464a-ba90-c725d9b68498/ASTRA-001, is fixed by the captured overlay. Restoring Math.min makes the unchanged caller compute stock - min(requested, stock). For nonnegative integer inputs, fulfillment is bounded by both demand and stock: requests at or above stock leave zero, and smaller requests leave stock minus requested. This eliminates both negative remaining stock and excess consumption, including zero-request behavior. The recorded base/head examples distinguish the regression, and the reported 121 passing repair checks cover every pair from 0 through 10, including all ordering and zero-boundary cases. Those finite checks corroborate the fix; the expression's bounds establish the general scoped invariant. No newly introduced risk is apparent in this exact restoration.
